scope: Five read-only reviewers inspected all 25 matching promotional boards and all 100 original full desktop/mobile closed/open captures, directly or via uncropped contact sheets. Parent additionally inspected Albania, Eswatini, Maldives and Sao Tome boards and fresh Slovenia mobile-open.
universal_limits: Static endpoints do not prove hinge attachment or sampled collision safety
Promotion and model differ in camera, lighting, object size and detail
Open lid obscuring its exterior miniature is not missing geometry
Cropped desktop headings in boards are not missing page UI; original full viewports are intact
adjudication: Preserve seven substantive fidelity holds. Remaining designs are recognizable unchanged review candidates with disclosed finish limits, not approved art. Delegated needs-user-review recommendations include final approval and ordinary finish differences; retain these recommendations separately rather than silently turning them into either proven runtime failures or authorizations for redesign. Parent reinspection of Albania/Eswatini supports recognizable simplification; Maldives/Slovenia hardware gaps are unresolved at screenshot scale, not established breakage.

entries.finding: Brighter uniform masonry and faceted roofs; three-building stone-city identity retained. Rim/hinge gap ambiguous.
Pale low faceted ridge and regular high-contrast zigzag ocean pattern differ substantially from promotional craggy ridge and enamel.
Recognizable framed straw weave; uniform tile-like strands, coarse diagonal lid and striped underside lose fibrous richness.
Sparse repeated rounded crowns and flat tan bank lose dense forest identity; pale river weak at mobile size and may read as path.
Lake/tree/rocks retained but water is opaque light cyan despite deep-blue copy; repetitive wood and simplified pale rocks.
Indigo striping and chest identity retained; fine-stripe aliasing, regular framing bands and conspicuous lid seam.
Bright dense caustic-like pattern replaces cloudy mineral impression; irregular pale base and blue stone depth reduced; angular pattern transitions.
Regular slat/grid weave and separated-looking lid coils lose tactility. Parent reinspection retains grass/coiled visual language, not demonstrated material-category substitution.
Flat regular village platform and repetitive fine wood streaks; wood/brass weakly differentiated.
Angular crowded flat botanical ornament and repetitive blue mottling lack sculptural cut-steel richness; stepped-looking rim joints.
Core stepped architecture retained; finer uniform blue courses, simpler pale ornament and yellow hardware. Patterned underside is not established missing-texture error.
Wavy brown surface can read wood/sediment rather than volcanic stone; opaque lakes and simplified relief. Mobile identifier visibility not proof of omitted content.
Trees/river/wood retained; regular wood bands, simplified foliage and gray feet lack promotional richness.
Ivory/turquoise atoll retained; flatter body/brass. Apparent open upper latch and rear gap do not prove detachment; front latch must disengage.
Floral/geometric identity retained; repetitive wood and flat textile motifs weakly convey walnut/weaving.
Lagoon/pinnacles retained with uniform simplified relief, flatter limestone/brass and weak grounding.
Lake/shore design retained with reduced mineral/rock/hardware richness; no visible viewport failure.
Bilum-like loops less distinct; highland relief, wood and hardware simplified.
Roof reads parallel strips rather than clearer promotional shingle grid; perimeter/timber detail reduced.

Flatter limestone/brass, stepped green-rim joins, coarse feet. Fresh mobile screenshot cannot resolve rear hinge interfaces sufficiently to prove breakage.
